x: Mawlānā Shaykh Sharafuddīn al-Dāghestānī · d. 1936 CE
Every petition sealed with the same refrain — *bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn*, by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds.
اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلٰى مَنْ لَّا نَبِيَّ بَعْدَهُ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ الَّذِيْنَ هَاجَرُوْا وَجَاهَدُوْا بِالنَّفْسِ وَالْمَالِ.
Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn, wa ṣ-ṣalātu wa s-salāmu ʿalā man lā nabiyya baʿdah, wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihi lladhīna hājarū wa jāhadū bi-n-nafsi wa l-māl.
Praise be to Allāh, Lord of the worlds; and blessing and peace upon him after whom there is no prophet, and upon his family and his Companions, who emigrated and strove with life and property.
اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ بِحَبِيْبِكَ الْأَعْظَمِ وَرَسُوْلِكَ الْأَفْخَمِ أَنْ تُعَيِّنَ لَنَا فِي جَمِيْعِ الْأُمُوْرِ فِي الْيَوْمِ وَغَدًا.
Allāhumma innā natawassalu ilayka bi-ḥabībika l-aʿẓam wa rasūlika l-afkham an tuʿayyina lanā fī jamīʿi l-umūri fī l-yawmi wa ghadan.
O Allāh, we seek a means to You through Your greatest beloved and Your most illustrious Messenger, that You appoint for us help in all our affairs, today and tomorrow.

فَإِنَّ جَاهَهُ عِنْدَكَ عَظِيْمٌ. اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ إِيْمَانًا لَّا ضِدَّ لَهُ، وَتَوْحِيْدًا لَّا يُقَابِلُهُ شِرْكٌ، وَطَاعَةً لَّا تُقَابِلُهَا مَعْصِيَةً، وَيَقِيْنًا لَّا يُقَابِلُهُ شَكٌّ، بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ فِي مِثْلِ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ الشَّرِيْفِ.

Fa-inna jāhahu ʿindaka ʿaẓīm. Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka īmānan lā ḍidda lah, wa tawḥīdan lā yuqābiluhu shirk, wa ṭāʿatan lā tuqābiluhā maʿṣiyah, wa yaqīnan lā yuqābiluhu shakk — bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīna fī mithli hādhā sh-shahri sh-sharīf.

For his standing with You is immense. O Allāh, we ask You for a faith that has no opposite, a declaration of oneness that no associating confronts, an obedience that no disobedience confronts, and a certainty that no doubt confronts — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds, in a month such as this noble one.

اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ التَّوْبَةَ وَدَوَامَهَا، وَنَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَعْصِيَةِ وَأَسْبَابِهَا، وَذَكِّرْنَا بِالْخَوْفِ مِنْكَ قَبْلَ هُجُوْمِ خَطَرَاتِهَا، وَأَفِضْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ بَحْرِ كَرَمِكَ وَجُوْدِكَ حَتّٰى نُخْرِجُ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى السَّلَامَةِ مِنْ وَّبَالِهَا بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ.

Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka t-tawbata wa dawāmahā, wa naʿūdhu bika mina l-maʿṣiyati wa asbābihā; wa dhakkirnā bi-l-khawfi minka qabla hujūmi khaṭarātihā; wa afiḍ ʿalaynā min baḥri karamika wa jūdika ḥattā nakhruja mina d-dunyā ʿalā s-salāmati min wabālihā — bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn.

O Allāh, we ask You for repentance and for its continuance, and we take refuge in You from disobedience and its causes. Remind us with fear of You before the onslaught of its promptings; and pour upon us from the sea of Your generosity and bounty, until we leave this world safe from its ruinous consequence — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds.

اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ لِسَانًا رَطْبًا بِذِكْرِكَ وَقَلْبًا مُنَعَّمًا بِشُكْرِكَ، وَبَدَنًا هَيِّنًا لَيِّنًا لِطَاعَتِكَ، وَأَعْطِنَا مَعَ ذٰلِكَ مَا لَا عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلَا أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلَا خَطَرَ عَلٰى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ، بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ فِي مِثْلِ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ الشَّرِيْفِ.

Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka lisānan raṭban bi-dhikrik, wa qalban munaʿʿaman bi-shukrik, wa badanan hayyinan layyinan li-ṭāʿatik; wa aʿṭinā maʿa dhālika mā lā ʿaynun raʾat wa lā udhunun samiʿat wa lā khaṭara ʿalā qalbi basharin — bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīna fī mithli hādhā sh-shahri sh-sharīf.

O Allāh, we ask You for a tongue moist with Your remembrance, a heart made glad by thankfulness to You, and a body easy and pliant in Your obedience. And give us, along with that, what no eye has seen and no ear has heard and what has not occurred to the heart of any man — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds, in a month such as this noble one.

اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ رِضْوَانًا تَصْحَبُهُ أَنْوَارُ مَحَبَّتِكَ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ ظَهَرَتِ السَّعَادَةُ عَلٰى مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَهُ، وَظَهَرَتِ الشَّقَاوَةُ عَلٰى مَنْ غَيْرُكَ مَلَكَهُ، فَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ مَّوَاهِبِ السُّعَدَاءِ، وَاعْصِمْنَا مِنْ مَّوَارِدِ الْأَشْقِيَاءِ، بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ.

Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka riḍwānan taṣḥabuhu anwāru maḥabbatik; fa-innahu qad ẓaharati s-saʿādatu ʿalā man aḥbabtah, wa ẓaharati sh-shaqāwatu ʿalā man ghayruka malakah. Fa-hab lanā min mawāhibi s-suʿadāʾ, wa ʿṣimnā min mawāridi l-ashqiyāʾ — bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn.

O Allāh, we ask You for a good pleasure attended by the lights of Your love; for felicity has appeared upon whomever You have loved, and wretchedness upon whomever another than You has possessed. So grant us of the gifts of the felicitous, and preserve us from the resorts of the wretched — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds.

اَللّٰهُمَّ يَسِّرْ لَنَا أُمُوْرَنَا مَعَ الرَّاحَةِ لِقُلُوْبِنَا وَأَبْدَانِنَا وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْعَافِيَةِ فِي دِيْنِنَا وَدُنْيَانَا، وَكُنْ لَّنَا صَاحِبًا فِي سَفَرِنَا وَخَلِيْفَةً فِي أَهْلِنَا، وَاطْمِسْ عَلٰى وُجُوْهِ أَعْدَائِنَا وَامْسَخْهُمْ عَلٰى مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ الْمُضِيَّ وَلَا الْمَجِيْءَ إِلَيْنَا

Allāhumma yassir lanā umūranā maʿa r-rāḥati li-qulūbinā wa abdāninā, wa s-salāmati wa l-ʿāfiyati fī dīninā wa dunyānā; wa kun lanā ṣāḥiban fī safarinā wa khalīfatan fī ahlinā; wa ṭmis ʿalā wujūhi aʿdāʾinā wa msakhhum ʿalā makānatihim fa-lā yastaṭīʿūna l-muḍiyya wa lā l-majīʾa ilaynā

O Allāh, make our affairs easy for us, with rest for our hearts and our bodies, and safety and well-being in our religion and our worldly life. Be a companion to us in our travel and a guardian over our household. And efface the faces of our enemies and transform them where they stand, so that they can neither go forward nor come toward us
(وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلٰى أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُوْ الصِّرَاطَ فَأَنّٰى يُبْصَرُوْنَ)
(Wa law nashāʾu la-ṭamasnā ʿalā aʿyunihim fa-stabaqū ṣ-ṣirāṭa fa-annā yubṣirūn)
(And had We willed, We would have blotted out their eyes, so that they raced to the path — but how could they see?)
بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ.
bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn.
by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds.

.اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ الْعِصْمَةَ فِي الْحَرَكَاتِ وَالسَّكَنَاتِ وَالْكَلِمَاتِ وَالْإِرَادَاتِ وَالْخَطَرَاتِ مِنَ الظُّنُوْنِ وَالشُّكُوْكِ وَالْأَوْهَامِ السَّاتِرَاةِ لِلْقُلُوْبِ عَنْ مُّطَالَعَةِ الْغُيُوْبِ
Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka l-ʿiṣmata fī l-ḥarakāti wa s-sakanāti wa l-kalimāti wa l-irādāti wa l-khaṭarāti — mina ẓ-ẓunūni wa sh-shukūki wa l-awhāmi s-sātirati li-l-qulūbi ʿan muṭālaʿati l-ghuyūb

O Allāh, we ask You for protection in our movements and our stillnesses, our words, our intentions and our passing thoughts — from the suspicions, doubts and fancies that veil hearts from beholding the unseen
بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ.
bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn.
by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds.

اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا جَامِعَ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيْهِ، إِجْمَعْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ الصِّدْقِ وَالْإِخْلَاصِ وَالنِّيَّةِ وَالْإِرَادَةِ وَالْخُشُوْعِ وَالْمُرَاقَبَةِ وَالْيَقِيْنِ وَالْوَقَارِ وَالتَّسْلِيْمِ وَالتَّفْوِيْضِ بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ.

Allāhumma yā Jāmiʿa n-nāsi li-yawmin lā rayba fīh, ijmaʿ baynanā wa bayna ṣ-ṣidqi wa l-ikhlāṣi wa n-niyyati wa l-irādati wa l-khushūʿi wa l-murāqabati wa l-yaqīni wa l-waqāri wa t-taslīmi wa t-tafwīḍ — bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn.

O Allāh, O Gatherer of mankind for a Day in which there is no doubt: join us with truthfulness and sincerity, right intention and resolve, humility and watchfulness, certainty and gravity, submission and entrustment — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds.
اَللّٰهُمَّ وَكُنْ لَنَا سَمْعًا وَّبَصَرًا وَّلِسَانًا وَّقَلْبًا وَّيَدًا وَّمُؤَيِّدًا بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ.
Allāhumma wa kun lanā samʿan wa baṣaran wa lisānan wa qalban wa yadan wa muʾayyidan — bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn.
O Allāh, be for us hearing and sight and tongue and heart and hand, and a support — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds.

اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا تُعَذِّبْنَا بِإِرَادَتِنَا وَحُبِّ شَهَوَاتِنَا فَنَشْغَلُ أَوْ نَحْجُبُ أَوْ نَفْرَحُ بِوُجُوْدِ مُرَادِنَا أَوْ نَسْخَطُ أَوْ نَسْلَمُ تَسْلِيْمَ النِّفَاقِ عَنْدَ الْفَقْدِ وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِقُلُوْبِنَا فَارْحَمْنَا بِالنَّعِيْمِ الْأَكْبَرِ وَالْمَدِيْدِ الْأَفْضَلِ وَالنُّوْرِ الْأَكْمَلِ وَالسَّعَادَةِ الْأَزَلِيَّةِ إِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ،

Allāhumma lā tuʿadhdhibnā bi-irādatinā wa ḥubbi shahawātinā fa-nashghala aw naḥjuba aw nafraḥa bi-wujūdi murādinā, aw naskhaṭa aw naslama taslīma n-nifāqi ʿinda l-faqd — wa anta aʿlamu bi-qulūbinā. Fa-rḥamnā bi-n-naʿīmi l-akbar, wa l-madīdi l-afḍal, wa n-nūri l-akmal, wa s-saʿādati l-azaliyyah; innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr,

O Allāh, do not punish us through our own wanting and our love of appetites, so that we become preoccupied, or veiled, or elated at getting what we wanted — or resentful, or submitting with the submission of hypocrisy when we lose it. You know our hearts better. So have mercy on us with the greatest bliss, the most excellent extension, the most perfect light, and the felicity that is without beginning. You have power over all things,
بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ فِي مِثْلِ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ الشَّرِيْفِ. اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لَّا يَسْكُنُ قَلْبٌ إِلَّا بِقُرْبِهِ وَأَنْوَارِهِ،
bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīna fī mithli hādhā sh-shahri sh-sharīf. Allāhumma yā man lā yaskunu qalbun illā bi-qurbihi wa anwārih,
by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds, in a month such as this noble one. O Allāh, O He without whose nearness and whose lights no heart is at rest,
وَلَا يَحْيَا عَبْدٌ إِلَّا بِلُطْفِهِ وَإِبْرَارِهِ، وَلَا يَبْقٰى وُجُوْدٌ إِلَّا بِإِمْدَادِهِ وَإِظْهَارِهِ،
wa lā yaḥyā ʿabdun illā bi-luṭfihi wa ibrārih, wa lā yabqā wujūdun illā bi-imdādihi wa iẓhārih,
and without whose gentleness and kindness no servant lives, and without whose sustaining and bringing-forth no existence endures,
يَا مَنْ آنَسَ عِبَادَهُ الرِّجَالَ وَالْأَخْيَارَ وَالْأَبْرَارَ وَأَوْلِيَائَهُ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ بِمُنَاجَاتِهِ وَأَسْرَارِهِ،
yā man ānasa ʿibādahu r-rijāla wa l-akhyāra wa l-abrāra wa awliyāʾahu l-muqarrabīna bi-munājātihi wa asrārih,
O He who has made His servants — the men of God, the choice and the righteous, and His close friends — intimate through His converse and His secrets,
يَا مَنْ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا وَأَقْصٰى وَأَدْنٰى وَأَسْعَدَ وَأَشْقٰى وَأَضَلَّ وَهَدٰى وَأَفْقَرَ وَأَغْنٰى وَعَافٰى وَأَبْلٰى وَقَدَّرَ وَقَضٰى كُلٌّ بِعَظِيْمِ تَدْبِيْرِهِ وَسَابِقِ تَقْدِيْرِهِ،
yā man amāta wa aḥyā, wa aqṣā wa adnā, wa asʿada wa ashqā, wa aḍalla wa hadā, wa afqara wa aghnā, wa ʿāfā wa ablā, wa qaddara wa qaḍā — kullun bi-ʿaẓīmi tadbīrihi wa sābiqi taqdīrih,

O He who gives death and gives life, who sets far and brings near, who makes felicitous and makes wretched, who leads astray and guides, who impoverishes and enriches, who grants well-being and afflicts, who apportions and decrees — all by the immensity of His governance and His prior determination,
(ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيْرُ الْعَزِيْزِ الْعَلِيْمِ) بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ. اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ أَيَّ بَابٍ يُقْصَدُ غَيْرُ بَابِكَ،
(dhālika taqdīru l-ʿAzīzi l-ʿAlīm) bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn. Allāhumma yā Rabbi, ayyu bābin yuqṣadu ghayru bābik,
(that is the determining of the Mighty, the All-Knowing) — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds. O Allāh, my Lord: what door is to be sought other than Your door,
وَأَيَّ جَنَابٍ يُتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْهِ غَيْرُ جَنَابِكَ،
wa ayyu janābin yutawajjahu ilayhi ghayru janābik,
and what presence is to be turned toward other than Your presence,

وَهَلْ فِي الْوُجُوْدِ رَبٌّ سِوَاكَ فَيُرْجٰى؟ أَمْ فِي الْمَمْلَكَةِ إِلٰهٌ غَيْرُكَ فَيُدْعٰى؟ أَمْ هَلْ كَرِيْمٌ غَيْرُكَ يُطْلَبُ مِنْهُ الْعَطَاءَ وَالْحَسَنَاتَ؟ أَمْ هَلْ حَاكِمٌ غَيْرُكَ تُرْفَعُ لَهُ الشَّكْوٰى؟ أَمْ هَلْ مِنْ مَجَالٍ لِلْعَبْدِ الْفَقِيْرِ يُعْتَمَدُ عَلَيْهِ؟ أَمْ هَلْ سِوَاكَ رَبٌّ تُبْسَطُ الْأَكُفُّ وَتُرْفَعُ الْحَاجَاتُ إِلَيْهِ؟ فَلَيْسَ إِلَّا كَرَمُكَ وَجُوْدُكَ

wa hal fī l-wujūdi rabbun siwāka fa-yurjā? Am fī l-mamlakati ilāhun ghayruka fa-yudʿā? Am hal karīmun ghayruka yuṭlabu minhu l-ʿaṭāʾu wa l-ḥasanāt? Am hal ḥākimun ghayruka turfaʿu lahu sh-shakwā? Am hal min majālin li-l-ʿabdi l-faqīri yuʿtamadu ʿalayh? Am hal siwāka rabbun tubsaṭu l-akuffu wa turfaʿu l-ḥājātu ilayh? Fa-laysa illā karamuka wa jūduk

and is there in existence a Lord besides You to be hoped in? Or in the kingdom a god other than You to be called upon? Or a generous one besides You from whom gift and goodness are sought? Or a judge besides You to whom complaint is raised? Or any recourse for the poor servant to rely upon? Or any Lord besides You to whom palms are spread and needs are lifted? There is nothing but Your generosity and Your bounty
يَا مَنْ لَّا مَلْجَأُ مِنْهُ إِلَّا إِلَيْهِ فَلَا تُخَيِّبْ رَجَائَنَا يَا قَدِيْمَ الْإِحْسَانِ بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ.
yā man lā maljaʾa minhu illā ilayh, fa-lā tukhayyib rajāʾanā yā Qadīma l-iḥsān — bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn.
O He from whom there is no refuge except to Him: do not disappoint our hope, O You whose beneficence is without beginning — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds.

اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا مَنْ يُّجِيْرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ، أَلْهَمْتَنَا فَعَرِّفْنَا، أَغَيْرُكَ هَا هُنَا رَبٌّ فَيُرْجٰى، أَوْ جَوَّادٌ فَيُسْأَلُ مِنْهُ الْعَطَاءَ؟ قَدْ جَفَانِي الْقَرِيْبُ وَمَلَّنِي الطَّبِيْبُ وَشَمَتَ بِي الْعَدُوُّ وَالرَّقِيْبُ، وَاشْتَدَّ بِي الْكَرْبُ وَالنَّحِيْبُ، وَأَنْتَ الْمُعِيْنُ وَأَنْتَ الْعَلِيْمُ الْقَادِرُ.

Allāhumma yā man yujīru wa lā yujāru ʿalayh, alhamtanā fa-ʿarrifnā. A-ghayruka hāhunā rabbun fa-yurjā, aw jawwādun fa-yusʾalu minhu l-ʿaṭāʾ? Qad jafānī l-qarību wa mallanī ṭ-ṭabīb, wa shamata bī l-ʿaduwwu wa r-raqīb, wa shtadda bī l-karbu wa n-naḥīb — wa anta l-Muʿīn, wa anta l-ʿAlīmu l-Qādir.

O Allāh, O He who grants protection and against whom none is protected: You have inspired us, so make us know. Is there here a Lord other than You to be hoped in, or a generous one from whom gift is asked? The near one has turned from me, the physician has wearied of me, the enemy and the watcher gloat over me, and grief and lamentation press hard upon me — and You are the Helper, You are the Knowing, the Able.
يَا رَبِّي إِلٰى مَنْ أَشْتَكِي وَأَنْتَ الْحَافِظُ الْكَرِيْمُ، أَمْ بِمَنْ أَسْتَنْصِرُ وَأَنْتَ الْوَلِيُّ النَّاصِرُ،
Yā Rabbī, ilā man ashtakī wa anta l-Ḥāfiẓu l-Karīm? Am bi-man astanṣiru wa anta l-Waliyyu n-Nāṣir?
My Lord, to whom shall I complain when You are the Guardian, the Generous? Or from whom shall I seek victory when You are the Protector, the Giver of victory?

أَمْ بِمَنْ أَسْتَغِيْثُ وَأنَتَ الْقَوِيُّ الْمَتِيْنُ، أَمْ إِلٰى مَنْ أَلْتَجِي وَأَنْتَ سَتَّارُ الْعُيُوْبِ؟ اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْفَوْزَ عِنْدَ الْقَضَاءِ وَمَنَازِلَ الشُّهَدَاءِ وَعَيْشَ السُّعَدَاءِ وَالنَّصْرَ عَلَى الْأَعْدٰى وَمُرَافَقَةَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ.

Am bi-man astaghīthu wa anta l-Qawiyyu l-Matīn? Am ilā man altajiʾu wa anta Sattāru l-ʿuyūb? Allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-fawza ʿinda l-qaḍāʾ, wa manāzila sh-shuhadāʾ, wa ʿaysha s-suʿadāʾ, wa n-naṣra ʿalā l-aʿdā, wa murāfaqata l-anbiyāʾ — bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn.

Or from whom shall I seek rescue when You are the Strong, the Firm? Or to whom shall I take refuge when You are the Veiler of faults? O Allāh, I ask You for triumph when the decree falls, the stations of the martyrs, the life of the felicitous, victory over enemies, and the company of the prophets — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds.

اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا مَنْ إِلَيْهِ يَلْجَأُ الْخَائِفُوْنَ، يَا مَنْ بِجَمِيْلِ عَوَائِدِهِ وَكَرَمِهِ يَتَعَلَّقُ الرَّاجُوْنَ، يَا مَنْ بِسُلْطَانِ قَهْرِهِ وَعَظِيْمِ رَحْمَتِهِ يَسْتَغِيْثُ الْمُضْطَرُّوْنَ، إِرْحَمْ بِجُوْدِكَ عَبْدًا مَا لَهُ سَبَبٌ يَرْجُوْ سِوَاكَ بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ.

Allāhumma yā man ilayhi yaljaʾu l-khāʾifūn, yā man bi-jamīli ʿawāʾidihi wa karamihi yataʿallaqu r-rājūn, yā man bi-sulṭāni qahrihi wa ʿaẓīmi raḥmatihi yastaghīthu l-muḍṭarrūn: irḥam bi-jūdika ʿabdan mā lahu sababun yarjū siwāk — bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn.

O Allāh, O He to whom the fearful take refuge; O He to whose beautiful habits and generosity the hopeful cling; O He by the sovereignty of whose overpowering and the immensity of whose mercy the desperate cry for rescue: have mercy by Your bounty upon a servant who has no recourse to hope in besides You — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَوَّلَ يَوْمِنَا هٰذَا صَلَاحًا وَّأَوْسَطَهُ فَلَاحًا وَآخِرَهُ نَجَاحًا بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ.
Allāhumma jʿal awwala yawminā hādhā ṣalāḥan wa awsaṭahu falāḥan wa ākhirahu najāḥan — bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn.
O Allāh, make the beginning of this day of ours rightness, its middle success, and its end attainment — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَوَّلَهُ رَحْمَةً وَأَوْسَطَهُ نِعْمَةً وَآخِرَهُ تَكْرِمَةً وَّمَغْفِرَةً بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ.
Allāhumma jʿal awwalahu raḥmatan wa awsaṭahu niʿmatan wa ākhirahu takrimatan wa maghfiratan — bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn.
O Allāh, make its beginning mercy, its middle blessing, and its end honour and forgiveness — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds.

اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ وَسُوْءِ القضَاءِ وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاء بِحُرْمَةِ مَنْ أَرْسَلْتَهُ رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ. وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِيْنَ

Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min jahdi l-balāʾ, wa daraki sh-shaqāʾ, wa sūʾi l-qaḍāʾ, wa shamātati l-aʿdāʾ — bi-ḥurmati man arsaltahu raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn. Wa ṣallā llāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn.

O Allāh, I take refuge in You from the rigour of affliction, from being overtaken by wretchedness, from an evil decree, and from the gloating of enemies — by the sanctity of him whom You sent as a mercy to the worlds. And may Allāh bless our master Muḥammad and all his family and Companions.
Duʿāʾ al-Shaykh Sharafuddīn — 29 bands.
